steps.notes: Set data-bus low for at least 18ms to send start signal
Wait 20-40us for sensor response after pulling low
Sensor pulls low for 80us as response signal
Sensor pulls high for 80us to prepare data
Read 40 bits: each bit starts with 50us low, then high pulse length determines bit value (26-28us for 0, 70us for 1)
Verify checksum: sum of first 4 bytes (integral RH, decimal RH, integral T, decimal T) should equal checksum byte

evidence_spans.snippet: Output signal   | digital signal via single-bus
When power is supplied to sensor, don't send any instruction to the sensor within one second
DATA=8 bit integral RH data+8 bit decimal RH data+8 bit integral T data+8 bit decimal T data+8 bit checksum

Data-bus's free status is high voltage level. When communication between MCU and AM2303 begin, program of MCU will transform data-bus's voltage level from high to low level and this process must beyond at least 18ms
then MCU will wait 20-40us for AM2303's response
AM2303 will send out low-voltage-level signal and this signal last 80us as response signal
every bit's transmission begin with low-voltage-level that last 50us

requires_human: The exact high pulse duration for bit 0 is not explicitly given; typical values are 26-28us, but datasheet only states 70us for bit 1. Human may need to confirm or measure.
The formula for converting raw data to physical values is not fully specified; human may need to infer decimal place or sign handling.
